title: Nickel / undo decisions
assumptions: Each question is independent. Quoted letters are text; Alice and Bo are writers.
Each listed edit is its own item unless explicit grouping or child membership is stated.
Concurrent means neither writer saw the other operation when issuing its own.
Some questions stipulate an observed intermediate result; that is not an endorsement of your earlier answer.
There is no answer key, score, adopted Nickel policy or CRDT simulation behind this questionnaire.

question.title: whose last edit?
events: Start with empty text. Alice inserts “a”. Bo receives it and appends “b”. Alice receives Bo’s edit; both see “ab”.
Alice presses undo.
question.prompt: which edit should Alice’s undo select?

choices.label: Alice’s insertion of “a”
Bo’s more recent insertion of “b”
neither; Bo’s edit blocks Alice’s undo
another outcome — explain below
depends / unsure — explain if you can
